resources.string: Google TV doesn\'t let you choose a different home screen. With this on, when the Home button opens Google TV\'s home, Kimono opens straight after it. It only notices Google TV\'s home coming to the front, and opens the TV\'s power menu when you choose the power button in Kimono\'s top bar. It doesn\'t read what\'s on screen in any app, and it doesn\'t collect or send anything. Turn it off here to go back to Google TV\'s home.
